live.instructions: Tools for the 64 hotels of the PLAZA Hotelgroup in Austria, Germany and the Netherlands. Every tool takes a hotel slug; call list_plaza_hotels first if the guest has not named a hotel. Never state room prices or availability from memory — always quote check_room_availability. To book, pass the offer_token from that availability result straight into create_room_reservation. It is valid once, for 30 minutes; do not re-run availability in between. If a tool reports it is unavailable, tell the guest to phone the hotel and use get_hotel_contact for the number.

tools.name: list_plaza_hotels
tools.title: List PLAZA hotels
tools.description: Lists the PLAZA hotels this server covers, with each hotel's name, city, the short identifier used for the hotel parameter, and whether room availability and reservations are handled online for that hotel or by the hotel on the phone. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: search_hotel_info
tools.title: Search hotel information
tools.description: Searches one PLAZA hotel's own knowledge base and returns the matching passages: room categories and features, breakfast, check-in and check-out times, parking, WiFi, pets, payment methods, wellness and conference facilities, restaurant and house rules. Returns recorded text about the hotel; it does not return availability or prices for specific dates.

hotel.description: Which PLAZA hotel the request is about, given as its short identifier (for example "schwerin"). Call list_plaza_hotels to get the identifiers of all hotels this server currently serves. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid identifiers.

query.description: What to look up about the hotel, in German or English, for example "check-in time", "Parkplatz Preis", "breakfast hours".

maxResults.description: How many knowledge-base passages to return (default 3, maximum 5).

tools.name: search_local_attractions
tools.title: Search attractions near a hotel
tools.description: Searches the sights and points-of-interest data recorded for one PLAZA hotel's city — landmarks, museums, churches, parks, lakes, viewpoints and similar — and returns a short description of each match.

hotel.description: Which PLAZA hotel the request is about, given as its short identifier (for example "schwerin"). Call list_plaza_hotels to get the identifiers of all hotels this server currently serves. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid identifiers.

query.description: What to look for near the hotel, in German or English, for example "museums", "Schloss", "walks with children".

maxResults.description: How many attractions to return (default 3, maximum 5).

tools.name: search_local_events
tools.title: Search local events
tools.description: Searches the local event calendar recorded for one PLAZA hotel's city (concerts, theatre, markets, exhibitions, festivals) and returns upcoming entries with date, time and venue. Events that have already taken place are excluded. Calendar data exists only for the cities where one is maintained; for the others the tool reports that no event data is available.

hotel.description: Which PLAZA hotel the request is about, given as its short identifier (for example "schwerin"). Call list_plaza_hotels to get the identifiers of all hotels this server currently serves. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid identifiers.

query.description: Optional text filter on event title, description or venue, for example "Konzert", "Weihnachtsmarkt".

when.description: Optional period filter relative to today.

date.description: Optional single calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for one specific day.

maxResults.description: How many events to return (default 3, maximum 5).

tools.name: get_hotel_contact
tools.title: Get hotel contact details
tools.description: Returns one PLAZA hotel's contact details as recorded in its own data: postal address, reception phone number and reception hours, general and reservations e-mail addresses, website, and WGS84 coordinates. Details that are not recorded for a hotel are left out of the response.

hotel.description: Which PLAZA hotel the request is about, given as its short identifier (for example "schwerin"). Call list_plaza_hotels to get the identifiers of all hotels this server currently serves. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid identifiers.

tools.name: check_room_availability
tools.title: Check room availability and prices
tools.description: Checks live room availability and total prices at one PLAZA hotel for given arrival and departure dates and a given occupancy, by querying the hotel's booking system. Works for every hotel in the list. Returns up to five options with room category, rate name, whether breakfast is included, and the total price for the whole stay, on flexible (free-cancellation) rates; most hotels sell each room both with and without breakfast, and the breakfast parameter restricts the quote to one of those when the guest has a preference. Nothing is reserved and no message is sent. For hotels connected to online booking, each option also carries a single-use booking token valid 30 minutes that create_room_reservation accepts. For all other hotels the prices are informational only: the response says so explicitly and gives the hotel's phone number, and there is no token — do not offer to book those, and do not tell the guest a room is held.

hotel.description: Which PLAZA hotel the request is about, given as its short identifier (for example "schwerin"). Call list_plaza_hotels to get the identifiers of all hotels this server currently serves. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid identifiers.

checkOut.description: Departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format, after the arrival date.

adults.description: Number of adults per room (1 to 5).

children.description: Ages in whole years of the children sharing the room, for example [4, 9]. Ages determine the rate. Omit when no children are travelling.

rooms.description: Number of rooms with this occupancy (1 to 4, default 1).

breakfast.description: Which board to quote. "either" (the default) returns a mix of rates with and without breakfast. Pass "included" when the guest wants breakfast, so that every option returned includes it and the choice is between rooms rather than between boards; pass "without" for room-only. If the hotel publishes no flexible rate on the requested board the response says so explicitly instead of quoting the other board.

tools.name: create_room_reservation
tools.title: Create a room reservation
tools.description: Creates a real reservation in a PLAZA hotel's booking system for one option that was quoted by an availability check, identified by that option's booking token, and has the hotel send the guest a confirmation SMS. Under EUR 200 total the hotel system confirms the booking directly and the guest pays at the hotel; from EUR 200 it instead creates an offer that the guest must confirm within 3 days by credit card via a link, otherwise it lapses and no room is held. The response states which of the two happened and returns the reservation number. Requires the guest's name, mobile number, e-mail address, home postal address and travel purpose. No payment card details are requested or transmitted by this tool. Each booking token can be redeemed once.

hotel.description: Which PLAZA hotel the request is about, given as its short identifier (for example "schwerin"). Call list_plaza_hotels to get the identifiers of all hotels this server currently serves. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid identifiers.

offer_token.description: The booking token that came with the chosen room option from the availability check, passed back unchanged. It carries the hotel, dates, occupancy, rate and price, is valid for 30 minutes and can be redeemed once.

first_name.description: Given name of the guest the room is booked for.

last_name.description: Family name of the guest the room is booked for.

email.description: Guest e-mail address; the hotel sends the booking confirmation, and for offers the confirmation link, to it.

phone.description: Guest mobile number with country code, for example +49 170 1234567; the confirmation SMS goes to it.

street.description: Street of the guest's own home address, as the guest states it. The house number may be included here instead of in street_number.

street_number.description: House number of the guest's home address, when it is not already part of street.

zip.description: Postcode of the guest's home address, for example 19053 or 1012 AB.

city.description: Town or city of the guest's home address.

country.description: Country of the guest's home address, as a name or a two-letter code, for example Deutschland or DE.

travel_purpose.description: Whether the stay is private or business travel. The hotel records this on the reservation.

salutation.description: Optional form of address for the reservation record.

notes.description: Optional request to pass to the hotel, for example "quiet room" or "late arrival around 23:00".

tools.name: resend_confirmation
tools.title: Resend booking confirmation SMS
tools.description: Sends the confirmation SMS for an existing reservation again, to a corrected mobile number, for a reservation that was created through this server during the current server session. Each call sends a real SMS. The message content is fixed by the hotel system; only the destination number can be given.

hotel.description: Which PLAZA hotel the request is about, given as its short identifier (for example "schwerin"). Call list_plaza_hotels to get the identifiers of all hotels this server currently serves. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid identifiers.

booking_reference.description: The reservation number from the booking confirmation.

phone.description: Corrected mobile number with country code, for example +49 170 1234567.
